plugins.description: Roadmap + backlog graph with the GitHub-first Gauntlet Loop as the primary meaningful-work path: /gauntlet conducts frozen-bar implementation, independent exact-SHA criticism, frozen-lead acknowledgment, repair, then fresh re-criticism and fresh acknowledgment. /fanout remains cross-slice concurrency; /sync reconciles durable GitHub results. The graph MCP includes all six Gauntlet tools plus roadmap/backlog planning and comment-preserving mutation.
